biggest_catch: You must hit $1,000+ in qualifying deposits in a SINGLE calendar month within 90 days — spread across two months doesn't count — and the bonus takes up to 120 days to land.
catches: Open new Frontwave Checking and Savings accounts on the same day (subject to approval); enroll in eStatements.
Receive at least $1,000 in qualifying ACH transfers or direct deposits during a single calendar month within 90 days of opening.
Bonus deposited into savings within 120 days if requirements are met and accounts remain in good standing.
New members age 18+ in San Diego, Riverside, Imperial, or San Bernardino counties, or via SEG/military affiliation.
Employees and volunteers excluded; anyone whose Frontwave account closed within the prior 18 months excluded.
